long_biography.plain_text:
Legal practice preceded Christos F. Kanellakis's career as a Greek shipowner. Maritime records placed him at Alpha Tankers & Freighters and identified him as both an owner and a senior representative of the Greek shipping community. He served on industry boards, including the Union of Greek Shipowners, and participated in Alpha's move beyond conventional tanker operations into gas shipping. These roles establish shipping as the sector that produced his identifiable business wealth.

Alpha's development was intertwined with the shipping platform of Anna Angelicoussis, whose inherited family interests separated from her brother's business around 2000. Kanellakis's precise capital contribution and ownership percentage were never publicly itemised. The current picture is clearer about who now operates the group. Recent trade coverage names Anna and her sons, and Alpha's own material presents Frangiskos Kanellakis on behalf of the owners. Christos no longer appears in current control descriptions, while his located outside directorships ended by 2013. This does not prove that he has no retained economic interest, but it prevents one from assigning Alpha's present companies or assets to him. His current primary industry, wealth origin and relationship to the surviving holdings therefore remain Unknown.
